snippet.title: .HEADSPACE - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Gameplay trailer for debut game .HEADSPACE by Diana Keith.

wishlist here: store.steampowered.com/app/3347280/HEADSPACE/

.HEADSPACE is a 2D adventure game that combines pixel art and hand drawn styles to immerse the player in a psychological adventure through a fractured landscape. Play as an unknown wanderer who has lost his memory and interact with a diverse cast of characters who may or may not have your best interest at heart.

Puzzle, visual novel, and walking sim elements weave together as you strive to unlock who you are and how to get home.

Featuring fully realized OST with intricately composed music by the inimitable Magic From Space, who also assisted with sound effects and contributed voice line work.
